doc.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995

title: Danny Turner, the alto player who just died
summary: She remembers the sweet, unobtrusive alto player Danny Turner, who sat next to Kenny Hing.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You know who else was a nice person in the band, Danny Turner, who also just recently passed away. Did you know Danny?
And he was an alto player. And he was very nice and very sweet. He just died about three weeks ago.
You would know him if you saw him.
He was very unobtrusive, and a small guy. He sat next to Kenny Hing.
